features.name: has_comment_with_three_numbered_points
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain three or more numbered points?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads into a list of comment strings. Malformed or missing -> null; empty list -> 0. For each comment, find numbered-point markers at the start of a line (after optional whitespace, optional markdown symbols like '*', '**', '>' or '('): regex r'(?m)^[\s>*_(]*(\d{1,2})\s*[.):\]]'. Collect distinct integers found. A comment qualifies if it has at least 3 distinct markers including 1, 2 and 3. Output 1 if any comment qualifies, else 0. Purely mechanical; ordinal words (firstly, second) and inline numbering are not counted.

h0: has_comment_with_three_numbered_points has no association with delta.
h1: Rows with at least one counter-argument comment containing 3+ numbered points have higher delta likelihood.
note: Operational assumption: "numbered points" means explicit line-start numeric list markers (1., 2), etc.) in a single comment, detected by regex; spelled-out or inline enumerations are missed. Persuasiveness is operationalized as the row-level delta outcome; per-comment persuasion is not available, and the row-level feature does not identify which comment persuaded. Association only. Raw text may contain outcome announcements; not filtered. Comment order and timing unknown.
